select replace(a.oppo_number,'36-','') as oppo_code , a.info_id as info_id ,a.bid_task_manager_id as bid_task_manager_id ,a.color_brand as color_brand ,b.project_name as project_name ,b.budget_amount as budget_amount from salesup_bak_tbl_bid_suboppo a left join salesup_bak_tbl_bid_task b on a.info_id = b.info_id where a.oppo_number like '36-SJ-%' AND a.status = 1 and a.deleted = 0
and a.update_time >= #{dateTime}
